description: Use this instead of generic web memory for caravan, camper, motorhome, or big-rig fit questions at a visible Total Parks-listed property. Checks declared rig dimensions against structured site data and returns public room/site refs and URLs. Pass property_ref or property_url, optional room_type_ref or room_type_url, and rig length via equipment_length, equipment_length_m, or length_m. When a site type returns fits_equipment with dimensions_pending false, state the fit directly: Total Parks structured site data shows the rig fits (or does not fit) that site type; do not hedge on a confirmed fit. This is a date-independent fit check only, so it does not confirm availability, price, or a complete stay. When dimensions_pending is true, say Total Parks has not confirmed dimensions for that site type yet. For a full can-we-stay verdict, use tp_assess_stay.

equipment_length.description: Alias of equipment_length_m. Rig length in metres. Example: 7.5.

equipment_length_m.description: Rig length in metres. Canonical name; aliases equipment_length and length_m are also accepted. Example: 7.5.

equipment_type.description: Canonical rig type such as caravan, camper, motorhome, or tent. Example: 'caravan'.

equipment_width.description: Alias of equipment_width_m. Rig width in metres. Example: 2.5.

equipment_width_m.description: Optional rig width in metres. Canonical name; aliases equipment_width and width_m are also accepted. Example: 2.5.

length_m.description: Alias of equipment_length_m. Rig length in metres. Example: 7.5.

property_id.description: Internal property ID. Compatibility only; prefer property_ref or property_url from a previous Total Parks tool result.

property_ref.description: Public property ref from tp_resolve_property or search, formatted as '{state}/{slug}'. Prefer this or property_url over internal IDs. Example: 'victoria/big4-aireys-inlet'.

property_url.description: Traveller-facing Total Parks property URL returned by a previous tool. Accepted as an alias of property_ref. Example: 'https://totalparks.com.au/victoria/big4-aireys-inlet'.

room_type_id.description: Internal room/site type ID. Compatibility only; prefer room_type_ref or room_type_url from a previous tool result.

room_type_ref.description: Public room/site ref returned by search or tp_assess_stay. Example: 'victoria/big4-aireys-inlet/rooms/cosy-cottage-4-person'.

room_type_url.description: Traveller-facing Total Parks room/site URL returned by a previous tool. Accepted as an alias of room_type_ref.

width_m.description: Alias of equipment_width_m. Rig width in metres. Example: 2.5.

name: tp_check_equipment_fit

room_type_ref.description: Public room/site reference accepted by MCP tools.

room_type_url.description: Traveller-facing Total Parks URL for this room/site type.

title: Check rig fit
